I now have a complete picture of the membership tier feature. Here is my thorough report.

## Summary

This is the **Spring PetClinic REST** app (`org.springframework.samples:spring-petclinic-rest`), converted to **OfficeFloor function injection**. The `membershipTier` feature is a derived, read-only field returned on owner responses. Response DTOs (`OwnerDto`) are **generated** from `src/main/resources/openapi.yml` by the `openapi-generator-maven-plugin` (v7.23.0) — there is no hand-written `OwnerDto.java`.

Important: the acceptance test suite already describes a **new, not-yet-implemented feature** ("membership-levels") that replaces the string `membershipTier` with a numeric `membershipLevel` (1–3). Grep confirms **`membershipLevel` does not exist anywhere in `src/main`** — only the string-tier implementation exists today.

## Build / test tooling

- **Maven** (with wrapper `./mvnw`). Root `pom.xml`; no Gradle files.
- Tests are plain JUnit 5 (`@Test` under `src/test`), so they run under Surefire: **`./mvnw test`** (full build/verify: `mvn clean install`, per `readme.md:218`).

## Core tier computation

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/MembershipTier.java`
The single source of tier logic. Note the Javadoc/behavior includes a `GOLD` tier based on `householdSize >= 3` — this is broader than the OpenAPI description (which only mentions SILVER/BRONZE).
```java
15	    public static String of(Owner owner, int namesakeCount, int householdSize) {
16	        if (householdSize >= 3) {
17	            return "GOLD";
18	        }
19	        boolean hasEmail = owner.getEmail() != null && !owner.getEmail().isBlank();
20	        return namesakeCount == 0 && hasEmail ? "SILVER" : "BRONZE";
21	    }
```

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/NamesakeCount.java`
Supplies the `namesakeCount` input to the tier (owners sharing first+last name, case-insensitive, excluding self by id). Body at lines 19–29 (see `of(Owner, OwnerRepository)`).

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/HouseholdSize.java`
Supplies the `householdSize` input (owners sharing normalized last name + address, self included). Body at lines 19–30.

## Where the tier is stored / returned

The tier is **not persisted**; it is computed per-response and set on the DTO in two OfficeFloor response functions:

### `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/RespondWithOwner.java` (GET response)
```java

14	        OwnerDto dto = ownerMapper.toOwnerDto(owner);
15	        int namesakeCount = NamesakeCount.of(owner, ownerRepository);
16	        dto.setNamesakeCount(namesakeCount);
17	        dto.setMembershipTier(MembershipTier.of(owner, namesakeCount, HouseholdSize.of(owner, ownerRepository)));
18	        dto.setLocality(Locality.of(owner));
```

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner, stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-02'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the same last name and address (they share a household).
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of first and last name, e.g. 'J.S.'.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Assigned membership code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', e.g. 'SMI-0007'.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registration date year, e.g. 'SMI-0007-M26'.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by all owners at the same last name and address (a household).
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners sharing this owner's first and last name (case-insensitive), counted just before this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: The owner's membership tier - 'SILVER' for an owner with an email and no namesakes (namesakeCount of 0), otherwise 'BRONZE'.
              type: string
              example: 'SILVER'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The region derived from the owner's city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' for any other city.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners were already created today (by registration date), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
